entries.2cbf8c2f34d58599: The breakdown of consolidated revenue of ¥104,280 million for the fiscal year ended May 2026, by segment revenue from external customers, is overseas wholesale business ¥82,862 million (about 79%), domestic wholesale business ¥13,193 million, retail business ¥4,062 million and other ¥4,161 million. By region, revenue was Europe and Middle East ¥26,007 million, Japan ¥21,417 million, United States ¥17,146 million, Asia ¥15,995 million, South America ¥10,442 million, and North and Central America (excluding the United States) ¥8,769 million, and the overseas total is about four times that of Japan. By product and service, seeds account for the bulk at ¥91,013 million, and materials are ¥4,945 million. Consolidated employees number 3,108.
entries.2e9073b79150f179: SAKATA SEED CORPORATION is a seed and seedling company headquartered in Tsuzuki-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture. It was founded in 1913 as Sakata Nōen, and the group consists of the company, 37 subsidiaries and 4 affiliates. Consolidated employees number 3,108 (as of May 31, 2026).
entries.32c9074639f6ee6c: Revenue from the overseas wholesale business
entries.333b5c2c57c8a0ff: The company and its 37 subsidiaries and 4 affiliates form a group that sells horticultural products (vegetable seeds, flower seeds, bulbs, seedlings, and horticultural and agricultural materials). Its head office is in Tsuzuki Ward, Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture, and consolidated headcount is 3,108 employees (as of May 31, 2026). After the war, it released melon varieties including Prince Melon and Andes Melon, and is also known for contributing to the spread of melons, which had been a luxury fruit.

entries.5a0ea57da3ad9848: This business produces or purchases vegetable seeds, flower seeds and seedlings and wholesales them to overseas seed companies and others. Besides the head office, overseas local subsidiaries such as Sakata Seed America,Inc. and Sakata Vegetables Europe S.A.S. handle it, and 34 companies including affiliates are assigned to it. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥82,862 million, making it the largest business in the Group.

Under the key statement “Cultivating Tomorrow's Harvest with You” (cultivating future abundance with you), it aims to lead the evolution of the seed and seedling industry as “the world's most trusted partner.” Its basic management approach is “Integrated Autonomy”: while respecting regional autonomy and pursuing global optimization, it works to achieve sustainable growth and higher corporate value through expansion into growth markets, stronger research and development, use of IT, DX and AI, and strengthening its global business foundation.
